answer.explanation: The live configuration of CompressionFunction sets ReservedConcurrentExecutions to 1 (last modified 2026-10-21T18:32:32Z, before the window), but the SAM template declares no reserved concurrency for it. During the window the function was invoked about 25-37 times per minute and was throttled 13-36 times per minute (roughly 20-30 throttles per minute on average), consistent with a concurrency cap of 1 that the IaC does not intend. The IAM role and IaC template are consistent with each other, so the cause is a live configuration change rather than an IAM or template problem. I did not have a CloudTrail tool to confirm who made the change.
